modules: COVER fixed prior-strata and image-feature diversity (common acquisition, not yet claimed independent contribution)

GT: all 18 raw conditions and 72 quantity controls sealed before this study evaluation; no target labels in adaptation or checkpoint selection
KITTI_only_four_videos: report point values and seed sensitivity, no fabricated population CI
old_v8p_table_comparability: old rho.3 full-perception/decode is historical reference only, not module effect; future matched rho.3 study may follow
